tool.name: Exome clinical interpretation report
tool.description: diagnostic, secondary, carrier, pharmacogenomic and risk findings in one human-readable report
tool.command: #if $bam: ln -s '$bam' input.bam && ln -s '${bam.metadata.bam_index}' input.bam.bai && #end if #if $mother_bam: ln -s '$mother_bam' mother.bam && ln -s '${mother_bam.metadata.bam_index}' mother.bam.bai && #end if #if $father_bam: ln -s '$father_bam' father.bam && ln -s '${father_bam.metadata.bam_index}' father.bam.bai && #end if #if $reference: ln -s '$reference' reference.fa && samtools faidx reference.fa && #end if python3 '$__tool_directory__/wes_clinical_report.py' --vcf '$vcf' #if $sample_name and str($sample_name).strip(): --sample-name '$sample_name' #else: --sample-name '$vcf.element_identifier' #end if #if $gencc: --gencc '$gencc' #end if #if $constraint: --constraint '$constraint' #end if #if $hpo_genes: --hpo-genes '$hpo_genes' #end if #if $hpo_terms and str($hpo_terms).strip(): --hpo-terms '$hpo_terms' #end if #if $hpo_annotations: --hpo-annotations '$hpo_annotations' #end if #if $clingen_dosage: --clingen-dosage '$clingen_dosage' #end if #if $clinvar_protein: --clinvar-protein '$clinvar_protein' #end if #if $mother_vcf: --mother-vcf '$mother_vcf' #end if #if $father_vcf: --father-vcf '$father_vcf' #end if #if $mother_bam: --mother-bam mother.bam #end if #if $father_bam: --father-bam father.bam #end if --affected-parents '$affected_parents' #if $cnv_calls: --cnv-calls '$cnv_calls' #end if #if $cnv_summary: --cnv-summary '$cnv_summary' #end if #if $clingen_regions: --clingen-regions '$clingen_regions' #end if #if $mother_cnv: --mother-cnv '$mother_cnv' #end if #if $father_cnv: --father-cnv '$father_cnv' #end if #if $roh: --roh '$roh' #end if #if $pharmcat: --pharmcat '$pharmcat' #end if #if $artefacts: --artefacts '$artefacts' #end if #if $bam: --bam input.bam #end if #if $reference: --reference reference.fa #end if #if $target_coverage: --target-coverage '$target_coverage' #end if #if $gene_coverage: --gene-coverage '$gene_coverage' #end if #if $coverage_summary: --coverage-summary '$coverage_summary' #end if #if $mane: --mane '$mane' #end if #if $gene_disease: --gene-disease '$gene_disease' #end if #if $vcep_rules: --vcep-rules '$vcep_rules' #end if #if $erepo: --erepo '$erepo' #end if #if $gnomad_coverage: --gnomad-coverage '$gnomad_coverage' #end if #if $pext: --pext '$pext' #end if #if $uniprot_features: --uniprot-features '$uniprot_features' #end if #if $gnomad_cnv: --gnomad-cnv '$gnomad_cnv' #end if #if $collins_dosage: --collins-dosage '$collins_dosage' #end if #if $mave: --mave '$mave' #end if #if $mito_tsv: --mito-tsv '$mito_tsv' #end if #if $mito_json: --mito-json '$mito_json' #end if #if $hla: --hla '$hla' #end if #if $previous_tsv: #import re #set $previous_name = re.sub(r"[^\w .,:()+-]", "_", str($previous_tsv.element_identifier)) --previous-tsv '$previous_tsv' --previous-name '$previous_name' #end if --max-af $max_af --min-ref-depth $min_ref_depth --max-candidates $max_candidates --html '$report' --tsv '$findings'

param.name: vcf
param.label: Annotated variants
param.help: Output of the WES tertiary workflow: SnpEff ANN/LOF/NMD, ClinVar CLNSIG/CLNREVSTAT/CLNDN, gnomAD v4.1 INFO/gnomAD_* fields.

param.name: sample_name
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Defaults to the dataset's element identifier.

param.name: gencc
param.label: Gene-disease validity (GenCC submissions TSV)
param.help: https://search.thegencc.org/download: gene-disease associations with mode of inheritance.

param.name: constraint
param.label: Gene constraint (gnomAD constraint metrics TSV)
param.help: gnomAD v4.1 constraint metrics (LOEUF, pLI, missense Z).

param.name: hpo_genes
param.label: HPO phenotype_to_genes.txt
param.help: HPO release file (propagated term to gene annotations).

param.name: hpo_terms
param.label: Patient phenotype (HPO terms)
param.help: Comma- or space-separated HPO ids, e.g. HP:0001250, HP:0001263. Used to rank candidates.

param.name: hpo_annotations
param.label: HPO disease annotations (phenotype.hpoa)
param.help: HPO release file: disease names, age of onset, clinical course and inheritance; with patient HPO terms, the disease that best explains the phenotype is shown for each gene.

param.name: clingen_dosage
param.label: ClinGen dosage sensitivity (ClinGen_gene_curation_list_GRCh38.tsv)
param.help: https://ftp.clinicalgenome.org/: haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity scores; decide whether loss of function is a disease mechanism (PVS1).

param.name: clinvar_protein
param.label: ClinVar missense variants by residue (TSV)
param.help: Built from ClinVar variant_summary.txt.gz with data/build_clinvar_protein.py in the workflow repository: ACMG PS1 (same amino-acid change pathogenic) and PM5 (another pathogenic change at the residue).

param.name: mother_vcf
param.label: Mother: variant calls (VCF)
param.help: The mother's calls on the same reference (raw or filtered; multi-allelic and complex records are split). With both parents: de novo variants, parental origin of every finding, compound heterozygotes phased by origin, parentage check.

param.name: mother_bam
param.label: Mother: aligned reads (BAM)
param.help: Reads at the proband's variants that the mother's calls lack: confirms de novo status (reference reads) or finds missed calls.

param.name: affected_parents
param.label: Affected parents
param.help: Whether a parent has the proband's condition: a dominant candidate inherited from an unaffected parent does not count as fitting the inheritance.

param.name: cnv_calls
param.label: Copy-number calls (wes_cnv calls TSV)
param.help: Deletions and duplications from the targets' read depth (Exome CNV calls tool): genes, ClinGen dosage, ACMG/ClinGen CNV points, inheritance fit, compound heterozygotes with small variants.

param.name: cnv_summary
param.label: Copy-number summary (wes_cnv JSON)
param.help: Panel, noise, chromosome dosage (trisomy, monosomy) and sex chromosomes from read depth.

param.name: clingen_regions
param.label: ClinGen dosage regions (ClinGen_region_curation_list_GRCh38.tsv)
param.help: https://ftp.clinicalgenome.org/: recurrent CNV regions (e.g. 22q11.2) and population regions where dosage sensitivity is unlikely.

param.name: mother_cnv
param.label: Mother: CNV per-target ratios (wes_cnv)
param.help: The mother's read-depth ratios at the proband's CNVs: inherited or de novo.

param.name: pharmcat
param.label: PharmCAT calls (TSV)
param.help: Calls-only TSV of the PharmCAT pharmacogenomics tool; shown next to the built-in star-allele genotypes.

param.name: artefacts
param.label: Recurrent artefacts of the laboratory (VCF)
param.help: Alleles called in many of the laboratory's own samples but rare or absent in gnomAD (build_artefact_list.sh in the workflow repository). Matching calls are marked low confidence, not removed.

param.name: bam
param.label: Aligned reads (BAM)
param.help: Read depth at pharmacogenomic and risk-allele positions (without it, absent variants cannot be told apart from missing coverage), and read-backed phase of two heterozygous variants in a recessive gene.

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference genome (FASTA)
param.help: Repeat context (homopolymers, tandem repeats) of reported variants.

param.name: gene_coverage
param.label: Coding-exon coverage (mosdepth thresholds BED, gene in column 4)

param.name: mane
param.label: MANE transcripts (MANE.GRCh38 summary)
param.help: https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/refseq/MANE/MANE_human/: variants named and classified on MANE Select transcripts, with the paired RefSeq NM_/NP_ names.

param.name: gene_disease
param.label: Curated gene-disease table (ClinGen, G2P, Orphanet)
param.help: Built with data/build_gene_disease.py in the workflow repository: inheritance and disease mechanism of each disease, and the disease-context section.

param.name: vcep_rules
param.label: ClinGen expert-panel rules (VCEP, from CSpec)
param.help: Built with data/build_vcep.py: gene-specific allele-frequency cut-offs, criteria and strengths of the ClinGen variant curation expert panels.

param.name: erepo
param.label: ClinGen expert-panel classifications (ERepo)
param.help: Built with data/build_vcep.py from the ClinGen Evidence Repository: the panel's own classification of a variant, shown next to ClinVar.

param.name: gnomad_coverage
param.label: gnomAD exome coverage (runs)
param.help: Built with data/build_gnomad_sites.py coverage from the gnomAD v4.0 exome coverage summary: no PM2 for an allele absent from gnomAD where fewer than half of gnomAD exomes reached 20x.

param.name: pext
param.label: Exon expression, pext (runs)
param.help: Built with data/build_gnomad_sites.py pext from gnomAD's GTEx v10 base-level pext: shown next to loss-of-function variants.

param.name: uniprot_features
param.label: Protein features (UniProt)
param.help: Built with data/build_uniprot_features.py from UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (CC BY 4.0): the domain, region or site at each variant's residue.

param.name: gnomad_cnv
param.label: gnomAD v4.1 exome CNVs (VCF)
param.help: gnomad.v4.1.cnv.all.vcf.gz (CC0): population frequency of each CNV call; benign evidence 4O when an ancestry group has it at 1 % or more.

param.name: collins_dosage
param.label: Predicted dosage sensitivity (Collins et al. 2022)
param.help: Collins_rCNV_2022.dosage_sensitivity_scores.tsv.gz (https://zenodo.org/records/6347673, CC BY 4.0): pHaplo/pTriplo of the genes in a copy-number variant.

param.name: mave
param.label: Functional assays (MaveDB, calibrated)
param.help: Built with data/build_mavedb.py from the MaveDB bulk download (CC0): PS3/BS3 at the strength of the assay's ACMG calibration.

param.name: hla
param.label: HLA types (wes_hla summary)
param.help: The summary (JSON) of the HLA typing tool (wes_hla): HLA alleles, the CPIC pharmacogenomic HLA alleles and HLA disease associations, shown in the pharmacogenomics section.

param.name: previous_tsv
param.label: Previous report of this sample: findings (TSV)
param.help: The findings TSV of an earlier run of this tool on the same sample. The report then lists what is new, what changed (ClinVar, ACMG class, category, genotype) and what is no longer reported, with the evidence that differs.

param.name: max_af
param.label: Rare variant cut-off (population allele frequency)
param.help: Applied to the higher of the overall gnomAD AF and the grpmax filtering AF (FAF95).

param.name: min_ref_depth
param.label: Reads needed to read an uncalled pharmacogenomic position as reference

param.name: max_candidates
param.label: Candidate variants shown in the report (all are in the TSV)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Turns the annotated variants of one exome into a self-contained HTML report for review by a clinical scientist, plus a TSV of every finding. All conclusions come from explicit, versioned rules applied to the inputs (ClinVar, GenCC, gnomAD, HPO, CPIC allele tables); there is no statistical or language model involved.
Sections:
1. Sample and data quality: variant counts, Ts/Tv, het/hom ratio, allele-balance contamination hint, genetic sex (chrX heterozygosity, chrY coverage), target coverage. 2. Diagnostic findings: ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants whose genotype fits the gene's mode of inheritance (GenCC); a review table for genes with mixed or unknown inheritance and X-linked heterozygous females. 3. Candidate variants not classified in ClinVar: rare predicted loss-of-function variants in established disease genes, rare missense variants with AlphaMissense at PP3_Moderate or stronger, in phenotype-matched genes or at a residue with a pathogenic ClinVar missense variant, and rare variants predicted by SpliceAI to alter splicing, with an automated ACMG/AMP classification: the evidence codes a VCF supports (PVS1 by the ClinGen SVI decision tree as far as SnpEff supports it, and only where ClinGen dosage, inheritance or constraint shows loss of function to be a disease mechanism; PM2, BA1, BS1, BS2 from gnomAD; PS1, PM5 and PM1 from the ClinVar residue table; PM4/BP3; PP2; PP3/BP4/BP7 at the ClinGen-calibrated strengths when the VCF carries INFO/AM_score and INFO/SpliceAI; PM3, PS2/PM6 and PP4 with matching phenotype terms) combined by the Bayesian point system (Tavtigian et al. 2020) into pathogenic, likely pathogenic, uncertain, likely benign or benign. The class is a draft for the analyst (no functional, segregation, case-count or literature evidence). ClinVar pathogenic findings show the automated class beside the ClinVar one, flagged when it is benign. With patient HPO terms, a table of the diseases that best explain the phenotype in the genes with findings.
Gene-disease cells also show GenCC disputed/refuted assertions, ClinGen dosage sensitivity, and (from the HPO disease annotations) age of onset, clinical course and inheritance. Two heterozygous variants in a recessive gene are phased from the reads when a BAM is given: variants in cis are one allele (carrier, not affected).
With the parents' calls (and optionally their BAMs) the report becomes a trio analysis: de novo variants (PS2/PM6 by the ClinGen SVI points, withheld if the parentage check fails), the parental origin of every finding, compound heterozygotes phased by origin, and dominant candidates inherited from a parent marked unaffected. Clusters of 3 or more parent-absent changes within 10 bp (paralogous reads) and heterozygous calls without reference reads (repeat or complex loci) stay *possibly de novo* without de novo points; a confirmed de novo variant with an alt fraction well below 0.5 is noted as possibly mosaic. With both parents, uniparental disomy is detected from common SNVs where the proband lacks one parent's alleles (whole chromosome or segment, isodisomy or heterodisomy, with the imprinting disorder of chromosomes 6, 7, 11, 14, 15, 16 and 20), and the parent of origin of a chromosome gain (allele balance at sites where the parents are opposite homozygotes) or of the X chromosomes in a sex-chromosome aneuploidy is given.
4. Copy-number variants and chromosome dosage (with the *Exome CNV calls* outputs): CNVs of clinical interest with their genes, ClinGen dosage and the ACMG/ClinGen CNV points that read depth supports (2A whole established haploinsufficient/triplosensitive gene or ClinGen region, 2E intragenic deletion, 2F inside a ClinGen benign population region, 2H/2I, 3 gene count, 5A de novo, 5B inherited from an unaffected parent); the inheritance fit (heterozygous loss of a dominant loss-of-function gene, homozygous or hemizygous loss in a recessive or X-linked gene, a deletion plus a small variant in a recessive gene: compound heterozygote, hemizygous when the variant lies inside the deletion and looks homozygous); the parents' read depth at each CNV; immunoglobulin/T-cell receptor loci flagged (somatic rearrangement); whole-chromosome gains and losses and the sex-chromosome complement (trisomy 21/18/13, XXY, 45,X, XXX, XYY). 5. ACMG SF v3.3 secondary findings (84 genes, gene-specific rules). 6. Carrier status for recessive conditions. 7. Pharmacogenomics: CPIC genes with single-nucleotide star alleles (CYP2C19, CYP2C9, VKORC1, CYP4F2, SLCO1B1, DPYD, TPMT, NUDT15, CYP3A5, CYP2B6, UGT1A1), PharmCAT diplotypes and phenotypes when given, and ClinVar drug-response variants. 8. Risk alleles (Factor V Leiden, prothrombin G20210A, HFE, APOE) and ClinVar risk/association variants. 9. Runs of homozygosity (bcftools roh) and uniparental disomy (trio). 10. Coverage of clinically relevant genes. 11. Methods and limitations.
**Knowledge sources (0.11).** With the MANE summary, variants are named and classified on the MANE Select transcript, with the RefSeq NM_/NP_ name and the 3'-shifted genomic HGVS. With the curated gene-disease table (ClinGen validity, Gene2Phenotype, Orphanet), a section lists every disease of each reported gene with its inheritance, mechanism and how the patient's genotype fits it; loss of function gets no PVS1 where the curated mechanisms are gain of function or dominant negative only. With the ClinGen expert-panel files, the panels' frequency cut-offs and code exclusions replace the defaults for their 129 genes, and the panel's own classification of a variant is shown next to ClinVar. REVEL (when in the missense file) is the first missense predictor. MaveDB calibrated assays give PS3/BS3. Collins dosage scores and gnomAD exome CNV frequencies are added to CNV calls, UniProt features to the variant names, and the wes_mito outputs give a mitochondrial section (including MT-RNR1 for aminoglycosides). The wes_hla summary adds the HLA alleles, the CPIC pharmacogenomic HLA alleles (abacavir, carbamazepine, allopurinol) and HLA disease associations to the pharmacogenomics section. Every input file is listed with its SHA-256, and a fingerprint identifies the data and rules.
**Reanalysis.** Given the findings TSV of an earlier report of the same sample, a section after the summary lists the results that are new, changed or no longer reported, matched by variant, by gene for gene-level results and by 50% reciprocal overlap for CNVs and uniparental disomy, with what each report said and the evidence that differs (ClinVar classification or review status, ACMG class, genotype, gnomAD frequency, QC flags; a variant no longer called). The TSV records the report version and the releases of HPO, GenCC, ClinGen and SnpEff (category report_meta), shown side by side with the previous report's. If the current calls lack most of the previous report's rare variants, the report warns that the previous report is probably of another sample.
Every flagged result must be confirmed by an orthogonal method in an accredited laboratory before clinical use.
